demonstrates: Cloned from lexilaube's 'I'm not saying we SHOULD, but.. / we coulddd..' — 354,828 likes on 155,000 followers, an engagement rate of 2.29 and by a wide margin the single biggest post in the entire corpus. Copied: an unstyled creator photo carrying one centred white serif line high in the frame, and a payoff slide that is a ROUTE, not designed artwork. The source screenshots Google Maps directly; redrawing Google's own interface would be fabricating another product's UI, so the card here is plainly ours and the real version should be a screenshot Yuval takes himself. Four Greek islands within one short flight, which is the Israeli version of the same fantasy.
